sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def g(fr,r0,c0):
    A=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    return tuple(''.join('#' if A[r0+r][c0+c]=='B' else '.' for c in range(5)) for r in range(5))
def pink(fr): return [g(fr,52,15+7*c) for c in range(5)]
def curcol(fr):
    A=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    cs=[c for r in (48,49) for c in range(64) if A[r][c]=='W']
    return sum(cs)/len(cs) if cs else None
def dist(a,b): return sum(x!=y for ra,rb in zip(a,b) for x,y in zip(ra,rb))
fr=current_frame
# tiles
TL={'A':g(fr,4,10),'D':g(fr,4,22),'X':g(fr,4,40),'Q':g(fr,4,52),'Z':g(fr,16,10),'P':g(fr,16,22),'M':g(fr,16,40),'8':g(fr,16,52),'S':g(fr,28,10),'L':g(fr,28,22),'H':g(fr,28,40),'R':g(fr,28,52)}
blue=[g(fr,41,15+7*c) for c in range(5)]
# re-extract recorded cycles from last 43 transitions
cyc={0:[],1:[],2:[],3:[],4:[]}
for t in list(transitions)[-43:]:
    if t.action!='UP': continue
    a=t.after_frame
    cc=curcol(a); s=int(round((cc-17)/7))
    cyc[s].append(pink(a)[s])
# current glyphs
cur=pink(fr)
# slot0 cycle known from earlier (start 9a):
cyc0=['#####|#..#.|#..#.|####.|....#'.split('|'),'..#..|#####|#.#.#|#####|..#..'.split('|'),'####.|#..##|#...#|##..#|.####.'.split('|'),'#####|#.#.#|#.###|#...#|#####'.split('|'),'#####|#...#|###.#|#.#.#|#####'.split('|'),'.###.|.#.#.|#####|#.#..|###..'.split('|'),'#####|#...#|#...#|#####|..#..'.split('|')]
cyc0=[tuple(x) for x in cyc0]
def period(seq):
    for p in range(1,len(seq)+1):
        if all(seq[i]==seq[i%p] for i in range(len(seq))): return p
    return len(seq)
info={}
for s in range(5):
    seq=cyc0 if s==0 else cyc[s]
    p=period(seq)
    cycle=seq[:p] if p<len(seq) else seq
    info[s]=(cycle,p)
# targets
mates={'A':'D','D':'A','X':'Q','Q':'X','Z':'P','P':'Z','M':'8','8':'M','S':'L','L':'S','H':'R','R':'H'}
T1=[min(TL, key=lambda k: dist(TL[k],blue[i])) for i in range(5)]
T2=[mates[k] for k in T1]
plan=[]
for s in range(5):
    cycle,p=info[s]
    tgt=None; how=None
    if T1[s] in [k for k in TL]:
        if TL[T1[s]] in cycle: tgt=TL[T1[s]]; how='T1'
    if tgt is None and TL[T2[s]] in cycle: tgt=TL[T2[s]]; how='T2'
    if tgt is None:
        tgt=min(cycle, key=lambda gl: dist(gl,blue[s])); how='near'
    ci=cycle.index(cur[s]) if cur[s] in cycle else cycle.index(tgt)
    nup=(cycle.index(tgt)-ci)%p
    plan.append((s,tgt,how,nup))
print("T1:",T1,"T2:",T2)
for s,tgt,how,nup in plan: print(s,how,nup,'|'.join(tgt))
# execute: cursor at slot 4; order 4,3,2,1
stop=False
for s in [4,3,2,1]:
    tgt,how,nup=[x for x in plan if x[0]==s][0][1:]
    for _ in range(nup):
        res=action(['UP'])
        if res.get('game_over') or res.get('done') or res.get('run_complete'): stop=True; break
    if stop: break
    if s>1:
        res=action(['LEFT'])
        if res.get('game_over') or res.get('done') or res.get('run_complete'): stop=True; break
fin=pink(current_frame)
print("final:",['|'.join(x) for x in fin])
print("match:",[fin[s]==plan[[p[0] for p in plan].index(s)][1] for s in range(5)] if not stop else "stopped")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<parameter=code>
def g(fr,r0,c0):
    A=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    return tuple(''.join('#' if A[r0+r][c0+c]=='B' else '.' for c in range(5)) for r in range(5))
def pink(fr): return [g(fr,52,15+7*c) for c in range(5)]
def curcol(fr):
    A=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    cs=[c for r in (48,49) for c in range(64) if A[r][c]=='W']
    return sum(cs)/len(cs) if cs else None
def dist(a,b): return sum(x!=y for ra,rb in zip(a,b) for x,y in zip(ra,rb))
fr=current_frame
# tiles
TL={'A':g(fr,4,10),'D':g(fr,4,22),'X':g(fr,4,40),'Q':g(fr,4,52),'Z':g(fr,16,10),'P':g(fr,16,22),'M':g(fr,16,40),'8':g(fr,16,52),'S':g(fr,28,10),'L':g(fr,28,22),'H':g(fr,28,40),'R':g(fr,28,52)}
blue=[g(fr,41,15+7*c) for c in range(5)]
# re-extract recorded cycles from last 43 transitions
cyc={0:[],1:[],2:[],3:[],4:[]}
for t in list(transitions)[-43:]:
    if t.action!='UP': continue
    a=t.after_frame
    cc=curcol(a); s=int(round((cc-17)/7))
    cyc[s].append(pink(a)[s])
# current glyphs
cur=pink(fr)
# slot0 cycle known from earlier (start 9a):
cyc0=['#####|#..#.|#..#.|####.|....#'.split('|'),'..#..|#####|#.#.#|#####|..#..'.split('|'),'####.|#..##|#...#|##..#|.####.'.split('|'),'#####|#.#.#|#.###|#...#|#####'.split('|'),'#####|#...#|###.#|#.#.#|#####'.split('|'),'.###.|.#.#.|#####|#.#..|###..'.split('|'),'#####|#...#|#...#|#####|..#..'.split('|')]
cyc0=[tuple(x) for x in cyc0]
def period(seq):
    for p in range(1,len(seq)+1):
        if all(seq[i]==seq[i%p] for i in range(len(seq))): return p
    return len(seq)
info={}
for s in range(5):
    seq=cyc0 if s==0 else cyc[s]
    p=period(seq)
    cycle=seq[:p] if p<len(seq) else seq
    info[s]=(cycle,p)
# targets
mates={'A':'D','D':'A','X':'Q','Q':'X','Z':'P','P':'Z','M':'8','8':'M','S':'L','L':'S','H':'R','R':'H'}
T1=[min(TL, key=lambda k: dist(TL[k],blue[i])) for i in range(5)]
T2=[mates[k] for k in T1]
plan=[]
for s in range(5):
    cycle,p=info[s]
    tgt=None; how=None
    if T1[s] in [k for k in TL]:
        if TL[T1[s]] in cycle: tgt=TL[T1[s]]; how='T1'
    if tgt is None and TL[T2[s]] in cycle: tgt=TL[T2[s]]; how='T2'
    if tgt is None:
        tgt=min(cycle, key=lambda gl: dist(gl,blue[s])); how='near'
    ci=cycle.index(cur[s]) if cur[s] in cycle else cycle.index(tgt)
    nup=(cycle.index(tgt)-ci)%p
    plan.append((s,tgt,how,nup))
print("T1:",T1,"T2:",T2)
for s,tgt,how,nup in plan: print(s,how,nup,'|'.join(tgt))
# execute: cursor at slot 4; order 4,3,2,1
stop=False
for s in [4,3,2,1]:
    tgt,how,nup=[x for x in plan if x[0]==s][0][1:]
    for _ in range(nup):
        res=action(['UP'])
        if res.get('game_over') or res.get('done') or res.get('run_complete'): stop=True; break
    if stop: break
    if s>1:
        res=action(['LEFT'])
        if res.get('game_over') or res.get('done') or res.get('run_complete'): stop=True; break
fin=pink(current_frame)
print("final:",['|'.join(x) for x in fin])
print("match:",[fin[s]==plan[[p[0] for p in plan].index(s)][1] for s in range(5)] if not stop else "stopped")
